messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm putting a draft up for an 'inspection replay' flow in Console. Goal: let SEs replay request/response pairs to debug customer issues but keep PII protected. Thinking masked-by-default, ephemeral unmask for support with strong audit trail. Thoughts?

jamal: +1 on masked-by-default. We should gate unmask with a ticket ID and TTL (1h), and log who unmasked. Also: sampling so we don't blow quotas.

oliver: Agree on sampling. We need to treat replay traffic as billable to the tenant and also count against request quotas, otherwise we'll get hot loops. Can we have a separate quota bucket: console.replay.* so ops can monitor?

sophie: From a privacy perspective: unmask should only reveal fields that were redacted, not switch off all redaction heuristics. Prefer HMAC-backed partial reveals instead of plain text. Also requires KMS approval for the unwrap key.

maria: Sketching config proposal:
```
inspect_replay:
  enabled: true
  sampling: 0.005            # 0.5% by default for autopilot
  require_ticket: true
  unmask_ttl_seconds: 3600  # ephemeral reveal
  reveal_audit: true
  reveal_reason_field: ticket_id
  route_level_override: false
```

jamal: Minor nit: sampling should be per-customer, deterministic (hash(session_id) mod 10000 < threshold) so debugging isn't biased. Also add an emergency allowlist for partner accounts.

oliver: Implementation note: replay service must run on dedicated infra (so we can enforce mem limits and burn-rate). We'll add a per-tenant replay quota and lifecycle metric. +alert if replay_tokens/sec > X.

sophie: UX: console must surface when a record was unmasked and who did it. Maybe an inline red pill: "Unmasked by jamal at 2024-07-15 14:02 (ticket #1234)". And redaction diff view so SEs see exactly which tokens were hidden.

maria: Regarding reveal HMAC — one design: store a salted HMAC of the original value in telemetry, and on unmask request, compute and compare. But we need KMS for the salt rotation. Sophie, can you draft an ops checklist for KMS?

sophie: Yup. Also recommend TTL-backed ephemeral keys (rotate hourly) so long-lived exposure is impossible.

jamal: Edge case: customer opt-out. Some regulated customers will want replay off entirely. We should support a per-tenant flag that disables replay and prevents any accidental unmask (even for SEs).

maria: Agreed. Add `tenant_replay_policy: {allow: bool, max_sampling_rate: float}`. Also UX: if replay is disabled, Console hides the button and shows "Replay disabled by tenant policy" with link to support docs.

oliver: Ops checklist: quota carveout, rate limiting, separate billing meter, alerting, and an emergency kill switch endpoint. Who owns rollout? Platform + Support.

maria: Plan for rollout: canary at 0.1% on internal tenants, 1% for early partners, then GA. Will wire up audit logs to log ingestion (immutable).

replay-bot: audit: created entry for thread 1718504321: candidate-policy-v1, users=[maria,jamal,sophie,oliver], status=DRAFT

jamal: Next steps: Sophie + Ops to write KMS checklist; Oliver to spec quota buckets and alerts; I'll add deterministic sampling helper in SDK; Maria will draft the Console UX copy. We'll sync on Thursday. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — I'll open the RFC PR and drop the draft config + UX mock in the doc.

oliver: One last callout: ensure telemetry emits a masked vs unmasked metric so Optimize and billing teams can reason about cost impact.

sophie: Also include a retention policy for replay artifacts (default 7 days, configurable by tenant) and encrypt at rest.

maria: Noted. OK closing the thread for now, will post RFC link when ready.
